name: Game Soup
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: Two grouse or partridges, or a pair of rabbits
ingredients.originalText: Two grouse or partridges, or a pair of rabbits
ingredients.quantityText: Two grouse or partridges, or a pair of rabbits

ingredients.name: lean ham
ingredients.originalText: half a pound of lean ham

ingredients.name: stalks of white celery cut into inch lengths
ingredients.originalText: two stalks of white celery cut into inch lengths

instructions.text: Joint your game neatly; cut the ham and onions into small pieces, fry all in butter to a light brown
Put into a soup-pot with the beef, cut into strips, add a little pepper
Pour on the water; heat slowly, and stew gently two hours
Take out the pieces of bird, and cover in a bowl
Cook the soup an hour longer; strain; cool
Drop in the celery and simmer ten minutes
Pour upon fried bread in the tureen

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Joint your game neatly; cut the ham and onions into small pieces, fry all in butter to a light brown
2. Put into a soup-pot with the beef, cut into strips, add a little pepper
3. Pour on the water; heat slowly, and stew gently two hours
4. Take out the pieces of bird, and cover in a bowl
5. Cook the soup an hour longer; strain; cool
6. Drop in the celery and simmer ten minutes
7. Pour upon fried bread in the tureen
